findings.title: Disabling NOC via the settings row while the panel is open leaves the panel stuck ON — drawn, scanned, and undismissable (D inert)
findings.evidence: app/main.odin:635 `if app.overlay_on {` (draw gate — no noc_enabled check); :520 `if app.overlay_on && app.run_live {` (feed scan); :893-894 `if app.noc_enabled { app.overlay_on = !app.overlay_on }` (D no-ops while disabled); :951 `app.noc_enabled = !app.noc_enabled` (row case never clears overlay_on). Verified: only two overlay_on assignments exist — boot :296 and the gated flip :894.
findings.detail: Reachable sequence: D (panel up) → S → activate 'NOC PANEL (D)' → OFF → close. overlay_on stays true, so draw_noc_overlay keeps rendering and the per-frame feed scan keeps running, while effect_overlay's noc_enabled gate makes D a no-op — the player cannot dismiss the surface they just disabled. Contradicts README ('turns the feature off entirely') and the PR body's removal claim ('D becomes a no-op, zero pixels in every frame'). Recoverable only by re-enabling the row. Confirmed against the worktree by all five lenses independently.
findings.recommended_fix: In the SETTINGS_ROW_NOC case, clear the panel when disabling: `app.noc_enabled = !app.noc_enabled; if !app.noc_enabled { app.overlay_on = false }` (or gate the draw + feed scan on `app.overlay_on && app.noc_enabled`); add a mutation-proven leg in app/noc_toggle_test.odin pinning disable-while-visible.

findings.title: Boot defaults (noc_enabled=true / overlay_on=false) unpinned — the unit pin asserts the test helper's own assignment, not main()'s boot
findings.evidence: app/main.odin:296-297 `app.overlay_on = false` / `app.noc_enabled = true`. app/noc_toggle_test.odin `noc_default_app :: proc() -> (app: App) { app.noc_enabled = true ... }` then `testing.expect(t, app.noc_enabled, "the availability flag defaults ON ...")` — the test sets the value it asserts.
findings.detail: Deleting `app.noc_enabled = true` from main() ships the feature dead (D inert, row shows OFF) with a fully green suite — the same D-lesson launch-path trap class this diff cites. The documented one-line removal flip would also fail no test (that half is intended, but nothing distinguishes intended flip from accidental deletion).
findings.recommended_fix: Factor boot defaults into a testable proc main() calls and pin it, or add a CI leg running PP_NOC_E2E=1 on the plain build so the real boot default is continuously proven.

findings.title: SETTINGS_ROW_COUNT 4->5 unpinned — no test reaches the NOC row through the real nav/click path
findings.evidence: grep over app/**/*_test.odin finds no reference to Settings_Navigate, Settings_Activate, settings_row_rect, or SETTINGS_ROW_COUNT. Nav wrap (exec.odin:61) and the click hit-test (exec.odin:738-739) both key off rnd.SETTINGS_ROW_COUNT.
findings.detail: The new tests address SETTINGS_ROW_NOC by constant directly. Reverting SETTINGS_ROW_COUNT to 4 keeps the whole suite green while the row becomes unreachable and invisible — the wiring is functionally correct (verified: nav wrap + hit-test loop derive from the constant) but unpinned.
findings.recommended_fix: Add an input-layer leg: open the panel, drive Settings_Navigate to row 4 (or synthetic click on settings_row_rect(4)), activate, assert the adjust hook fires with SETTINGS_ROW_NOC.

findings.title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
findings.evidence: Rollup — components independently confirmed: P0 100% (effect happy+negative pins mutation-proven by Perkins on the worktree; input-chain pin in input/noc_key_test.odin; e2e pixel proof re-measured 0.0% OFF / 97.9% ON; goldens untouched). P1 ~85%: flag effect, row wiring, label, non-persistence pinned; boot default, row reachability, disable-while-visible boundary unpinned.
findings.detail: P0 100%, P1 ~85%, overall >=80% → CONCERNS. The three unpinned P1 items are the two warnings above plus the blocker boundary leg.
findings.recommended_fix: Add the three missing pins (boot-default, nav/click reachability of row 4, disable-while-visible) to raise P1 >=90% for PASS.

findings.title: The self-exiting e2e drive (synthetic D injection, screenshots, mkdir bin, forced exit) now compiles into every build behind only the PP_NOC_E2E env var
findings.evidence: `app.noc_e2e = os.get_env_alloc("PP_NOC_E2E", context.allocator) != ""` — verified in the worktree; the injection/capture/exit blocks are gated only by app.noc_e2e.
findings.detail: Spec-consistent (run-dev.sh --e2e must work in the normal build — acceptance 'run-dev.sh unchanged in behavior' — and the PR body documents 'env-gated, not compile-gated' as a decision). Recorded as a hardening observation (CWE-489 class): a stray PP_NOC_E2E in a player/CI shell hijacks the run and self-exits. The boot-time env string is never freed (one-shot, pre-existing pattern).
findings.recommended_fix: Optional: re-gate only the noc_e2e blocks behind a define for store builds, or document the release-visible behavior; free the env string after reading.

findings.title: NOC-row presentation beyond the pure label helper unpinned (value_chip_color case + draw_hud snapshot wiring)
findings.evidence: grep: no test references value_chip_color; the snapshot field `noc_enabled = app.noc_enabled` in draw_hud has no pin. The settings_row_label helper IS pinned (noc_settings_row_is_the_discoverability_line).
findings.detail: Deleting the chip-color case or the snapshot wiring renders a stale ink/OFF row while the feature works. Cosmetic, and consistent with the four pre-existing rows (also unpinned at this layer).
findings.recommended_fix: Optional: factor the Settings_Snapshot construction into a pure proc and pin it; the chip color can stay unpinned.

rejected_findings.title: PR body claims the settings 'row hit-test' convention was followed, but no diff hunk updates hit-testing or panel geometry for the fifth row
rejected_findings.reason: False positive. All geometry and hit-testing derive from SETTINGS_ROW_COUNT: settings_panel_rect height (settings_panel.odin), settings_row_rect bounds-check (`row >= SETTINGS_ROW_COUNT`), the draw loop (`0..<SETTINGS_ROW_COUNT`), the app click hit-test (app/input/exec.odin:738-739 loops the count over rnd.settings_row_rect), and nav wrap (exec.odin:61). No 4-row hardcode exists; no hunk was needed.

rejected_findings.title: noc_mark only advances while the panel is open — first D press folds the entire run's event backlog in one frame
rejected_findings.reason: False positive. The one-shot full-history fold is the documented design (noc_overlay.odin:77 'folded by noc_feed_scan (incremental or one-shot)'), required for the feed's since-start counters (start_run resets feed+mark together, main.odin:701-702). Per-event cost is a switch + bounded counter increments (no allocation); the same watermark-scan discipline runs every frame for the audio consumer (main.odin:493-498). Snapping the mark on open would blank the history the panel exists to show.
